usage.notes: Panacea calls Open Food Facts through server/src/lingkungan.ts and normalizes only selected product identity and per-100g nutrient fields. React components must not call the upstream API directly. The adapter intentionally does not invent serving-size conversions because package serving definitions are heterogeneous and user-entered data quality varies.

license.scope: Open Food Facts database data are made available under the Open Database License. Commercial reuse is allowed subject to attribution and the ODbL share-alike/database obligations. This registry entry covers database fields consumed by the current adapter; product images, packaging artwork and other individual content can have separate rights and are not licensed by this entry.
license.notes: If Panacea creates or publicly distributes a derivative database by combining Open Food Facts data with other databases, review the ODbL share-alike requirements before release. Preserve Open Food Facts attribution. The current adapter does not import product images.

validation.notes: Open Food Facts is crowdsourced product data and can be incomplete, stale or incorrect. Nutrient values are reference inputs, not laboratory measurements or a validated clinical nutrition prescription. Panacea should preserve product identity and missing-data semantics and must not fabricate absent nutrient fields.

provenance.authority: Open Food Facts community-maintained open food-products database
provenance.notes: Every normalized product should retain the source identity and product code when available. Because records are continuously edited by contributors, reproducible research or regulatory use requires a dated export/snapshot rather than assuming the live API is immutable.

adapter.notes: The backend adapter uses a custom User-Agent, caches results for 24 hours, selects a bounded field set, normalizes finite non-negative nutrient values per 100 g, drops products without a usable energy value, and returns an empty result on upstream failure rather than fabricated nutrition data. API rate limits and upstream availability remain operational dependencies.
